mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) inhibits prostaglandin synthesis and may reduce progesterone's effects; NSAIDs can also increase gastrointestinal bleeding risk and affect renal function, potentially altering progesterone metabolism and efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced contraceptive/therapeutic efficacy of progesterone and gastrointestinal bleeding; consider alternative analgesia or use gastroprotection if NSAID is necessary; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
